<observation>The screenshot shows an order confirmation page with two main sections: "Your order" and "Your receipt". The "Your order" section displays the customer's name and email, which is readable. However, the content of "Your receipt" is obscured by a large dark green overlay that covers the entire area where the receipt details (item labels, amounts, total) should be displayed. This overlay prevents the user from reading any information in the receipt section. Additionally, collection instructions are not visible in the current view, as they are likely located below the obscured area.</observation>
<data-json>
{
  "status": "candidate",
  "observation": "The receipt details and collection instructions are not readable due to a large dark green overlay covering the relevant sections.",
  "issues": [
    {
      "location": "Your receipt section",
      "reason": "The receipt details are obscured by a large dark green overlay, making it impossible to read item labels, amounts, or the total.",
      "visibleEvidence": "A large dark green rectangle covers the 'Your receipt' section, blocking all text and details."
    },
    {
      "location": "Collection instructions area",
      "reason": "Collection instructions are not visible because they are likely located below the obscured area.",
      "visibleEvidence": "The lower part of the screen is covered by the dark green overlay, preventing visibility of any potential collection instructions."
    }
  ]
}
</data-json>

When DATA_DEMAND is a JSON object, the keys in your response must exactly match the keys in DATA_DEMAND. Do not rename, translate, or substitute any key.
